annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (broken): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
